content.comment_body: In a [product_name] configuration with one [product_name] CPU supplied by 24VAC, is it possible to add an [product_name] analog module and supply only the module with 24VDC? In an electrical panel, there is a logic module [article_no] ([product_name] 24RC) powered by 24VAC. I need to extend the existing [product_name] setup with an analog module [article_no], which requires 24VDC power. Can I keep the logic module powered by 24VAC and supply only the analog expansion with 24VDC? Thanks.

[product_name] analog modules can be connected to any base module, regardless of the supply type for the base module. These analog modules require either DC12V or DC24V; AC power is not permitted. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are verifying if base and expansion [product_name] modules can operate together when powered by different sources—specifically AC for the base module and DC for the expansion. The focus is on ensuring safe and reliable compatibility for mixed power supplies within the same setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the base [product_name] module to run on 24VAC and the analog expansion to be powered by 24VDC, both operating together without reliability issues.
